The issue calls the packing a different local minimum from #481's, by numerical evidence at 80 digits, not interval proofs: KKT, strict modulo 92 exact flat motions against #481's 111, no corner-corner MILP descent, 102 + 1057 contact equations, 114 corner-corner contacts, 18 rattlers and 40 tilted squares, 29 of them load-bearing, at 37.7379 degrees (26), 43.8654 (2) and 44.0334 (1); matched by optimal assignment over the eight box symmetries, 209 load-bearing squares move by more than 1e-4 and 20 by more than 1e-2 (at most 0.747), and no tilt angle is shared.

The issue says the packing came from a replication test of #481: #481's s(236) Mondrian composition rebuilt from Kingbird's s(152)_r2 corner piece and the register's s(88) (itsnaka, #422) in a box of side s(88) + 6, then the author's basin explorer (fixed-side perturbation and re-polish, 45 minutes on one core) descended below #481, and exactsolve.py certified the point; it asks that itsnaka's SQUISH Mondrian composition (#481) be credited for the construction.
No closed form, no interval proof of local optimality and no optimality claim.
